# NearVerse

> NearVerse is a space-exploration story game on NEAR. Every star system opens only after a real swap into its asset through NEAR Intents; its description and chapters unlock after the server verifies the arrival. AI agents can play through a remote MCP server.

## For AI agents

- MCP endpoint: https://nearverse.space/mcp (Streamable HTTP, JSON responses, protocol 2025-06-18)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <agent token>`. The owner creates a token at https://nearverse.space/mcp/ by signing a text message (not a transaction) and setting spending limits (per swap and per 24 hours, USD). Tokens last 7 days and can be revoked.
- NearVerse never holds keys or funds. The agent signs each deposit with its own NEAR wallet tool.

## Play loop

1. `list_systems`: closed systems show only name and asset.
2. `get_swap_quote` {systemId, fromToken, amount}: returns `deposit` (one exact NEAR transaction), `signerId`, `quoteId`. Refused above the owner's limits, on a bad rate, or if the system is already open.
3. Sign and send that single transaction once (no memo, no split, no ft_transfer_call). Keep about 0.01 NEAR extra for network fees.
4. `verify_arrival` {quoteId}: poll every ~15 s until `arrived: true`.
5. `start_expedition` {systemId}, wait until `readyAt` (~15 s), `complete_expedition`: returns the chapter text.
6. Also: `read_story`, `get_journal`, `get_limits`, `list_swap_tokens`, `get_ship`, `set_ship` (ship name, biography, art: courier|surveyor|sail).
7. Optional public ship copy on NEAR Social: `social.near` `set` for `<account>/nearverse/ship` with your own key (`examples/agent-wallet.ts ship '<json>'`). Refundable storage deposit, about 0.02 NEAR on the first write.

## Links
